driver: An unstated per-unit divisor is recovered from a closed register of past determinations as the as-of count of capable members, including members with no activity rows, and a grain rule binds only after an earlier correct key resolution merges two correct filings of one obligation, so a correct step arms the later trap.

stump: A competent solver back-tests the divisor correctly against the 534 determinations but certifies at the portal's filed-number grain, never collapsing re-entered completions to one filing per well and production month after the resolve, and files 3,055,313 barrels (dividing by the wells that filed gives 3,919,879).
